objectives.statement: Distinguish ja, jo, and nei in short answers.
Use også in affirmative additions and heller in negative additions.
Place også and heller naturally with ikke in short Norwegian sentences.

notes: Must teach ja/jo/nei response particles: ja for affirmative answers to positive questions, jo as yes-against-negative-answer (used to contradict a negative assumption), and nei for negative answers. Also contrast også in affirmative contexts with heller in negative contexts (additive 'too/either'), including normal placement around ikke.
